reels.title: The Patio Newark: Full Experience
reels.concept: Follow the talent through a complete night at The Patio — from the chef plating the signature dish in the kitchen, to cocktails at the bar, to the group vibing on the patio. This is the hero Reel that shows every dimension of the space in one fluid story.
reels.goal: Establish The Patio as a complete experience destination for Black and Latina women in Newark — not just a meal, but a whole vibe from kitchen to patio.
reels.hook: Open on tight shot of chef's hands plating signature dish in kitchen under focused light — immediate luxury food content that stops the scroll before viewers even know where they are.
reels.audienceReactionGoal: Save this spot for their next Newark girls' night. Feel like they got an insider look at a spot that delivers on food, drinks, and atmosphere.

sequence.label: Kitchen Opening
sequence.purpose: Hook with high-value food content and behind-the-scenes access that immediately signals quality.
sequence.description: Tight shot of chef's hands plating signature dish in kitchen. Focus on precision, garnish, drizzle. THE PATIO | KITCHEN signage visible in background blur.
shotsNeeded: Overhead or side angle of chef plating signature dish with deliberate precision
Close-up of garnish or sauce being added
Quick cut to finished plate being lifted
Kitchen signage in soft focus background
sequence.editingDirection: Fast cuts synchronized to music beat. Keep tight and intimate. Warm color grade to emphasize lighting.

sequence.label: Bar Transition
sequence.purpose: Establish the bar as a destination and introduce talent naturally receiving their order.
sequence.description: Wide shot of bar counter with pendant lights, then cut to bartender sliding two signature cocktails across the dark counter toward Kayla and Amber seated at bar. They react with genuine excitement.
shotsNeeded: Wide establishing shot of bar counter under pendant lights with THE PATIO branding visible
Medium shot of bartender sliding cocktails across counter
Reaction shot of Kayla and Amber receiving drinks
Close-up of cocktails on dark counter surface with lighting highlighting colors
sequence.dialogue: Kayla (natural, not scripted): 'Wait, this is gorgeous'
sequence.editingDirection: Smooth transition from kitchen to bar. Let the pendant light create visual continuity. Hold on cocktail close-up for 1.5 seconds.

sequence.label: First Bite Moment
sequence.purpose: Deliver the food payoff and genuine talent reaction that validates the quality.
sequence.description: Signature dish arrives at bar. Kayla takes first bite while Amber watches. Real reaction, not performed. Cut to close-up of the dish, then back to Kayla's face.
shotsNeeded: Server or chef placing signature dish on bar counter
Close-up of dish from overhead showing both components clearly
Wide shot of Kayla taking first bite with Amber leaning in
Tight shot of Kayla's genuine reaction
B-roll of second bite or Amber reaching for her fork
sequence.dialogue: Kayla (authentic reaction): 'Oh this is—' Amber: 'That good?' Kayla: 'Yeah that's the one'
sequence.editingDirection: Let the reaction breathe. Don't cut too fast. Real moments sell better than performed ones. Audio mix should capture authentic conversation.

sequence.label: Group Energy Shift
sequence.purpose: Transition to the patio and show this is a spot for groups, not just couples or solo diners.
sequence.description: All four talent now on the patio. Nia and Dee have joined. Group is laughing, cocktails in hand, relaxed body language. Multiple angles of genuine interaction — not posed, just vibing.
sequence.dialogue: Natural conversation audio mixed low under music, occasional laughter audible
sequence.editingDirection: Multiple quick cuts showing different pairs and angles. Energy should feel spontaneous. If patio has natural light, use it. If evening/night, lean into warm artificial lighting.

sequence.label: Verdict Moment
sequence.purpose: Deliver the BBO Stamped verdict clearly and confidently without corporate language.
sequence.description: Kayla addresses camera directly from patio with group visible behind her. She delivers the verdict in BBO voice — direct, confident, no hedging.
shotsNeeded: Medium shot of Kayla addressing camera with group and patio in background
Quick cut to group behind her still vibing
Return to Kayla for final line
B-roll of bar or food as visual punctuation
sequence.dialogue: Kayla to camera: 'The Patio got the food, the drinks, and the vibe. Newark girls, this is the spot. We're stamping it.'
sequence.editingDirection: Kayla's delivery should feel natural and authoritative. Cut to group behind her when she says 'the vibe' to show proof. End on her confident final line.

sequence.label: Closing Shot
sequence.purpose: End with branding and location information while maintaining the vibe.
sequence.description: Final wide shot of the bar with pendant lights and THE PATIO | KITCHEN signage clearly visible. Group silhouettes visible on patio in background if possible. Hold for location tag and handle.
shotsNeeded: Wide shot of bar counter with signage and lighting showcased
Optional: slow push-in on branding
Optional: final shot of cocktails on counter
sequence.editingDirection: Clean, simple end. Let the space speak. Hold shot long enough for viewers to read handle and location. Music fades out or cuts cleanly.

audioDirection.direction: Uptempo instrumental with warm, smooth energy that works for both food content and group vibes. Not aggressive club music, not soft jazz — something in between that feels like a night out but still polished. Beat should hit on key editing cuts.

reels.title: Signature Dish Spotlight
reels.concept: A tight, food-focused Reel that follows the signature dish from chef's hands to first bite. This is pure culinary content for the foodie algorithm — less talking, more showing.
reels.goal: Drive food-motivated traffic to The Patio by showcasing the signature dish as a must-try item in Newark.
reels.hook: Open on extreme close-up of signature dish component being plated — a detail so appetizing viewers stop mid-scroll.
reels.audienceReactionGoal: Comment 'What is this called?' and 'Where in Newark?' Save for their food bucket list. Tag friends who need to try it.

sequence.label: Plating Sequence
sequence.purpose: Hook with high-detail food prep that shows craft and quality.
sequence.description: Series of tight shots showing chef building the signature dish step by step in the kitchen. Each component gets a moment. Hands move with confidence and precision.
shotsNeeded: Extreme close-up of first component being placed on plate
Chef's hands adding second element
Sauce or garnish being drizzled or placed with precision
Quick overhead of complete dish before it leaves kitchen
Shot of chef's focused expression or hands wiping plate edge
sequence.voiceover: Kayla (confident, not overly excited): 'The Patio's signature dish. Chef plates it himself.'
sequence.editingDirection: Tight, methodical cuts. Each shot should be 1-2 seconds max. Let the food be the star. Warm color grade. Shallow depth of field where possible.

sequence.label: The Presentation
sequence.purpose: Show the finished dish in the actual dining environment to bridge kitchen and experience.
sequence.description: Finished dish is placed on the dark bar counter under pendant lighting. Camera circles or pushes in slowly. Lighting hits the dish perfectly. No hands, no distraction — just the food.
shotsNeeded: Wide shot of dish being set on bar counter
Slow push-in or circle around dish showcasing both components
Overhead shot showing dish composition against dark counter
Side angle showing depth and plating height if applicable
sequence.editingDirection: Slow down here. Let viewers take it in. This is the hero moment for the dish. Music should build slightly.

sequence.label: First Bite Payoff
sequence.purpose: Validate the food with genuine human reaction that viewers trust.
sequence.description: Amber takes the first bite at the bar. Real reaction — eyes, face, body language. Cut to close-up of fork cutting through the dish, then back to her reaction.
shotsNeeded: Medium shot of Amber taking first bite
Close-up of fork cutting into dish showing texture
Tight shot of Amber's face reacting
Optional: second angle of her nodding or saying something to Kayla off-camera
sequence.dialogue: Amber (natural, minimal): 'Okay. Yeah.' or just a genuine facial reaction with no words
sequence.editingDirection: Keep it real. Over-the-top reactions kill credibility. A subtle nod or genuine surprise is more valuable. Audio can be minimal or mixed low.

sequence.label: The Stamp
sequence.purpose: Close with clear call-to-action and location information.
sequence.description: Final shot of the dish on the counter with THE PATIO branding visible in background. Hold for handle and location tag.
shotsNeeded: Clean final shot of dish with bar and signage in background
Optional: pull-out revealing more of the bar environment
sequence.editingDirection: Simple, clean end. No need to overcomplicate. The food already did the work.

audioDirection.direction: Minimal, atmospheric instrumental that doesn't compete with voiceover. Something with subtle rhythm but not overpowering — think moody, sophisticated, food-focused. Low-end warmth without heavy bass.

sequence.label: Bar Environment

sequence.description: Series of shots showcasing the bar area — pendant lights, dark counter, THE PATIO | KITCHEN signage, clean lines. No people yet, just space and mood.
shotsNeeded: Wide shot of bar counter with pendant lights and signage
Close-up of pendant light fixture
Slow pan across bar surface
Detail shot of branding or architectural element

Close-up of Nia holding cocktail glass near face, light hitting it perfectly
Over-the-shoulder shot of Kayla with her drink, bar in background

sequence.label: Closing Visual
sequence.purpose: End with a clean, beautiful shot that makes viewers want to visit and post their own content.
sequence.description: Final shot of two cocktails side by side on the dark counter under perfect lighting. Hold for location tag. No people, no movement — just the drinks and the vibe.
shotsNeeded: Overhead or straight-on shot of two cocktails on counter
Ensure THE PATIO branding is visible in background blur
Perfect lighting showcasing drink colors

camera.movement: Static or slow push-in on final garnish

shots.title: Bar Counter Wide Establishing with Pendant Lights
shots.description: Wide shot of the bar counter under pendant lights with THE PATIO | KITCHEN signage visible in frame. Dark counter surface, warm lighting from above. May include stylized cocktail and food elements if present.

camera.framing: Wide shot capturing full counter, lights, and signage
camera.movement: Static or slow push-in on signage

props: Stylized cocktail glasses or food elements if present

shots.subject: Bartender sliding signature cocktails to talent

camera.framing: Medium shot capturing bartender's hands, cocktails, and counter surface
camera.movement: Static or slight pan following the slide

shots.subject: Kayla and Amber receiving cocktails

shots.editingNote: Cut to this immediately after the slide. The reaction should feel spontaneous and connected to the previous shot.

shots.title: Cocktails Close-Up on Dark Counter
shots.description: Close-up of the two signature cocktails on the dark bar counter, lit by the pendant lights above. Focus on the colors, glassware, and contrast against the dark surface.

shots.subject: Two signature cocktails

camera.framing: Close-up on both cocktails, slightly overhead or straight-on

shots.subject: Signature dish being placed in front of talent

shots.subject: Signature dish

camera.framing: Overhead close-up, full plate in frame

shots.talentDirection: No talent in frame. Dish is styled and lit optimally on the counter.

shots.title: Kayla First Bite with Amber Watching
shots.description: Wide shot of Kayla taking the first bite of the signature dish while Amber leans in and watches. Both talent visible, seated at the bar. Pendant lights and bar aesthetic in frame.

shots.subject: Kayla tasting signature dish, Amber reacting

camera.framing: Wide shot, both talent visible from waist or chest up

shots.title: Kayla Reaction Close-Up

shots.subject: Kayla's facial reaction

camera.framing: Tight close-up, shoulders to top of head

shots.talentDirection: Kayla takes the bite and reacts naturally. The camera is close, so the reaction must be genuine — no exaggeration, no performance. Just the honest response to the taste.
shots.editingNote: Cut to this immediately after the wide shot of the first bite. This is the reaction the editor will build the beat around. If the reaction is strong, hold it. If it's subtle, cut quickly.

shots.title: Second Bite or Amber Reaching In

shots.title: Sauce or Garnish Precision
shots.description: Tight shot of sauce being drizzled or garnish being placed with precision. The finishing touch that completes the dish.
shots.purpose: Peak moment of the plating sequence showing craft and attention to detail.
shots.location: Kitchen prep station or plating area
shots.subject: Sauce drizzle or garnish placement

camera.framing: Close-up to extreme close-up
camera.movement: Static or slight tilt-down following drizzle

shots.talentDirection: Chef executes final garnish or sauce with deliberate, smooth motion. One continuous action per take.
shots.editingNote: Use the cleanest, most visually satisfying execution. This is the money shot of the prep sequence.

shots.title: Overhead Complete Dish in Kitchen
shots.description: Quick overhead shot of the completed dish on the prep station before it leaves the kitchen. Shows full composition.
shots.purpose: Caps the plating sequence and transitions to presentation. Reveals the complete work.
shots.location: Kitchen prep station or plating area
shots.subject: Completed signature dish

camera.framing: Overhead, medium-tight on plate

shots.talentDirection: Chef steps back or holds position. Plate is stationary and perfectly positioned.
shots.editingNote: Brief hold, 1-2 seconds max. Punctuation before the reveal at the bar.

shots.title: Chef Focus or Plate Wipe
shots.description: Shot of chef's focused expression while working or hands wiping the plate edge clean before service.
shots.purpose: Humanizes the preparation, shows care and professionalism.
shots.location: Kitchen prep station or plating area
shots.subject: Chef's face or hands finishing plate

camera.framing: Medium close-up on face or close-up on hands

shots.talentDirection: Chef works naturally. If face shot, capture concentration. If hands, show the final wipe or adjustment.
shots.editingNote: Optional insert to add texture to the sequence. Use if pacing needs variety or to emphasize craftsmanship.

shots.title: Dish Set on Bar Counter Wide
shots.description: Wide shot of the finished dish being placed onto the dark bar counter under the pendant lights. Captures the transition from kitchen to presentation.
shots.purpose: Establishes the dish in its hero location and begins the presentation beat.
shots.subject: Signature dish being set down on counter

camera.framing: Wide, showing counter, dish, and lighting

shots.talentDirection: Server or chef places dish gently and confidently on the counter, then exits frame.
shots.editingNote: Cut in as dish enters frame or just after it's set. Establishes the environment and lighting.

shots.title: Slow Push-In on Dish
shots.description: Slow, steady push-in or circle around the dish on the bar counter. Lighting from pendant hits perfectly. No hands, no distraction—just the food.
shots.purpose: Hero moment for the dish. Pure product showcase with cinematic movement.
shots.subject: Signature dish on counter

camera.framing: Medium to close-up

shots.talentDirection: No talent in frame. Dish is stationary and perfectly lit.
shots.editingNote: This is the glamour shot. Use the smoothest take with perfect lighting. Speed up slightly in edit if needed to fit timing.

shots.title: Side Angle Dish Depth
shots.description: Side angle showing depth and plating height of the dish if applicable. Reveals dimensionality.
shots.purpose: Adds visual variety and showcases dish structure if it has vertical elements.
shots.subject: Signature dish from side

camera.framing: Medium close-up, side profile

shots.talentDirection: No talent. Dish is positioned to show profile.
shots.editingNote: Use only if dish has notable height or layering. Otherwise skip.

shots.title: Amber First Bite Medium
shots.description: Medium shot of Amber seated at the bar taking the first bite of the signature dish. Capture real reaction—eyes, face, body language.
shots.purpose: Delivers the payoff moment. Authentic reaction sells the experience.
shots.subject: Amber eating and reacting

camera.framing: Medium shot, chest up

shots.talentDirection: Amber takes a genuine first bite. Let the reaction happen naturally—eyes, facial expression, body language. No performance, just real response.
shots.dialogue: Optional natural reaction sounds or brief comment
shots.editingNote: Cut in just before bite, hold through chewing and initial reaction. Use the most authentic take.

shots.title: Fork Cutting Through Dish XCU
shots.description: Extreme close-up of fork cutting into the dish, revealing texture and interior. Shows what the bite actually delivers.
shots.purpose: Insert that heightens anticipation and showcases food texture.
shots.subject: Fork cutting through signature dish

camera.framing: Extreme close-up on fork and dish

shots.talentDirection: Amber or stand-in hand cuts through dish with fork in one smooth motion. Show the texture reveal.
shots.editingNote: Quick insert between bite and reaction. Use cleanest cut with best texture reveal.

shots.title: Amber Face Reaction Tight
shots.description: Tight shot of Amber's face reacting to the dish. Eyes, expression, the moment of approval.
shots.purpose: Emotional punctuation of the taste experience.
shots.subject: Amber's face reacting

camera.framing: Close-up, face only

shots.talentDirection: Amber reacts naturally after tasting. Eyes, nod, smile—whatever is genuine. No forced performance.
shots.editingNote: Cut back to this after the fork insert. Use the most expressive moment.

shots.title: Amber Nod or Comment to Kayla
shots.description: Second angle of Amber nodding or saying something to Kayla off-camera. Adds social dimension to the reaction.
shots.purpose: Optional extension of reaction beat if more coverage is needed.
shots.subject: Amber reacting toward Kayla

camera.framing: Medium shot, slight profile

shots.talentDirection: Amber turns slightly and makes a brief comment or nod to Kayla off-camera. Keep it natural and conversational.
shots.dialogue: Brief natural comment like 'Yo, this is fire' or similar
shots.editingNote: Use only if reaction beat needs extension or social element. Otherwise skip.

shots.title: Final Dish with Branding
shots.description: Clean final shot of the dish on the bar counter with THE PATIO branding visible in the background. Hold for handle and location tag.
shots.purpose: Closing stamp. Reinforces brand and location while showcasing the dish one last time.
shots.subject: Signature dish with THE PATIO branding in background

camera.framing: Medium wide, dish in foreground, signage in background

shots.talentDirection: No talent. Dish is positioned with clear sightline to THE PATIO | KITCHEN signage.
shots.editingNote: Hold for 3-4 seconds. Room for handle, location tag, and final voiceover line. Pull-out optional if it reveals more environment.

shots.title: Cocktail Placement on Bar Counter
shots.description: Low angle shot of bartender placing signature cocktail on dark bar counter under pendant light. Camera positioned slightly below counter level, angled up. Pendant light illuminates drink from above. Capture the moment glass touches surface and bartender's hand releases.
shots.purpose: Opens the Reel with immediate product focus and establishes the bar's dark aesthetic with warm lighting contrast.
shots.location: Bar counter, positioned to capture pendant light directly above placement spot
shots.subject: Signature cocktail being placed by bartender

camera.framing: Low angle, slightly below counter level, angled upward to capture glass, hand, and pendant light in same frame
camera.zoomOrLens: 35mm equivalent or wider to capture context while keeping drink prominent
camera.movement: Static locked-off, let the action provide movement

shots.talentDirection: Bartender: Place glass deliberately but naturally on counter. Hold hand on glass for half-second after placement, then pull away smoothly. Repeat for multiple takes with consistent placement spot.
shots.editingNote: Cut on the moment glass contacts counter or just before. Can play at regular speed or 50% slow-mo depending on music tempo. Use the cleanest take where light hits glass perfectly and hand movement is smooth.

shots.title: Cocktail Close-Up Under Pendant Light
shots.description: Tight close-up of signature cocktail glass on counter, shot from slightly above bar level. Pendant light creates rim lighting and illuminates the drink's color. Frame shows drink detail, garnish, and how the pink or orange/gold color pops against dark background.
shots.purpose: Hero product shot showing cocktail detail and color vibrancy under the venue's signature lighting.
shots.location: Bar counter directly under pendant light, same placement spot as shot 1
shots.subject: Signature cocktail glass with garnish

camera.framing: Close-up, slightly above bar level, isolating glass with minimal background
camera.zoomOrLens: 50mm equivalent or tighter to compress and isolate subject

shots.talentDirection: No talent in frame
shots.editingNote: Use as insert cut during beat 1 to showcase drink detail. Hold for 1-2 seconds. Ensure color saturation is accurate and light creates appealing contrast.

shots.title: Overhead Cocktail on Dark Counter Texture
shots.description: Directly overhead shot of cocktail on dark bar counter. Camera positioned straight down, capturing drink from above with counter texture visible around it. Pendant light creates circular pool of light around glass.
shots.purpose: Provides alternative angle for beat 1 and establishes overhead perspective used in closing beat.
shots.location: Bar counter under pendant light, camera rigged or handheld directly overhead
shots.subject: Signature cocktail from overhead perspective

camera.framing: Overhead, straight down, centered on glass with counter texture filling frame edges
camera.zoomOrLens: 35mm equivalent to capture drink and surrounding counter

shots.talentDirection: No talent in frame
shots.editingNote: Optional insert for beat 1 if needed for pacing. Can also serve as transition into beat 2 environmental shots.

shots.title: Pendant Light Fixture Close-Up
shots.description: Close-up of single pendant light fixture showing its design and warm glow. Frame isolates the light against dark background, capturing how it creates the venue's signature lighting aesthetic.
shots.purpose: Detail shot for beat 2 that showcases the venue's lighting design and creates visual variety in environmental sequence.
shots.location: Bar counter area, camera positioned to isolate one pendant light fixture
shots.subject: Pendant light fixture

camera.framing: Close-up on single pendant light, isolated against dark background or ceiling
camera.zoomOrLens: 50mm equivalent to compress and isolate fixture

shots.talentDirection: No talent
shots.editingNote: Use as quick insert during beat 2 environmental montage. 1 second hold maximum. Creates visual punctuation between wider shots.

shots.title: Slow Pan Across Bar Surface
shots.description: Slow horizontal pan across empty bar counter surface, starting from one end and moving across the dark texture. Camera at bar level or slightly above. Pendant lights create pools of light along the pan. Movement reveals the length and clean lines of the space.
shots.purpose: Provides movement and flow during beat 2 environmental sequence. Shows the bar's linear design and dark aesthetic.
shots.location: Bar counter, camera positioned at counter level for lateral pan
shots.subject: Bar counter surface and pendant lights

camera.framing: Medium shot at bar level, panning horizontally across counter length
camera.zoomOrLens: 35mm equivalent for natural perspective during movement
camera.movement: Slow, steady horizontal pan from left to right (or right to left), 4-5 second duration

shots.talentDirection: No talent. Ensure bar surface is clean and styled.
shots.editingNote: Use full pan or cut into it during beat 2. Creates cinematic movement between static environmental shots. Pan should be smooth and deliberate, not rushed.

shots.title: Branding or Architectural Detail
shots.description: Detail shot of THE PATIO | KITCHEN signage, logo, or distinctive architectural element visible in the bar area. Close enough to show texture and design, but recognizable as branding.
shots.purpose: Reinforces venue identity during beat 2 and provides branding coverage for client.
shots.location: Bar counter area where THE PATIO | KITCHEN signage or branding is visible
shots.subject: THE PATIO | KITCHEN branding or architectural detail

camera.framing: Close-up or medium close-up on branding element, ensuring it's recognizable but artfully framed

shots.talentDirection: No talent
props: THE PATIO | KITCHEN signage or branded element
shots.editingNote: Quick insert during beat 2, 1-1.5 seconds. Reinforces location and brand without being heavy-handed.

shots.title: Wide Two-Shot of Nia and Kayla at Bar
shots.description: Wide shot of Nia (talent-3) and Kayla (talent-1) seated at bar counter with cocktails. Both are in frame, pendant lights hang above them creating pools of light. They're laughing and talking naturally, existing in the space. Camera captures them as part of the aesthetic, not performing for camera.
shots.purpose: Establishes both talent in the space for beat 3. Shows group content and how people enjoy the venue.
shots.location: Bar counter, camera positioned to capture both talent with pendant lights and bar environment visible
shots.subject: Nia and Kayla at bar with cocktails

camera.framing: Wide shot capturing both talent from waist or chest up, bar counter in lower frame, pendant lights above
camera.zoomOrLens: 35mm equivalent to capture both subjects and environment
camera.movement: Static hold, let talent provide movement

shots.talentDirection: Nia and Kayla: Sit naturally at the bar with your cocktails. Have a real conversation, laugh, sip your drinks, react to each other. Don't look at camera. You're just two friends enjoying the vibe. Let moments happen naturally — we'll capture them.
shots.dialogue: Natural conversation between talent, not scripted
shots.editingNote: Opens beat 3 or serves as establishing shot for talent sequence. Cut to moments where interaction feels genuine and lighting is flattering. Can intercut with closer shots from this same setup.

shots.title: Close-Up Nia with Cocktail Near Face
shots.description: Close-up of Nia holding cocktail glass near her face, pendant light illuminating both her and the drink. Frame captures her expression and the drink's color together. She's not posing — just naturally holding her drink while talking or reacting, and the light hits perfectly.
shots.purpose: Hero talent moment for beat 3 that combines product and personality. Shows how the cocktail looks in context with a person enjoying it.
shots.location: Bar counter, camera positioned close to Nia, pendant light directly above or slightly in front
shots.subject: Nia with cocktail glass

camera.framing: Close-up from shoulders up, cocktail glass held near face, pendant light visible or creating rim lighting
camera.zoomOrLens: 50mm equivalent to compress background and isolate subject

shots.talentDirection: Nia: Hold your cocktail naturally near your face — like you're about to take a sip or just brought it up while talking. Look at Kayla or off-camera, not at lens. React naturally to conversation. We're capturing the in-between moments.
shots.dialogue: Natural reactions and conversation, not scripted
shots.editingNote: Use best moment where Nia's expression is genuine, light hits both her and the drink beautifully, and drink color pops. Cut holds 1.5-2 seconds in beat 3.

shots.title: Over-Shoulder Kayla with Drink and Bar Background
shots.description: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Kayla, showing her holding her cocktail with the bar environment in background. Pendant lights, dark counter, and depth of bar visible behind her. She's engaged in conversation with Nia (who may be slightly visible or out of frame).
shots.purpose: Provides reverse angle for beat 3 and shows bar environment from talent perspective. Creates depth and variety in talent sequence.
shots.location: Bar counter, camera positioned behind Kayla looking toward bar depth
shots.subject: Kayla with cocktail, bar environment in background

camera.framing: Over-shoulder, Kayla's shoulder and partial back in foreground left or right, her drink visible, bar environment in focus behind

shots.talentDirection: Kayla: Sit naturally, hold your drink, talk with Nia. We're shooting from behind you to show the bar environment. Just stay engaged in conversation — your body language and the space behind you are what we're capturing.
shots.editingNote: Use as cutaway during beat 3 to show environment from talent POV. Creates spatial awareness and breaks up direct talent shots. 1-1.5 second hold.

shots.title: Medium Two-Shot Laughing with Drinks
shots.description: Medium shot of both Nia and Kayla laughing naturally together, both holding cocktails. Frame is tighter than shot 8 — chest up or waist up. Pendant lights above, dark bar aesthetic visible but talent and drinks are the focus. Capturing genuine moment of connection and enjoyment.
shots.purpose: Key moment for beat 3 showing authentic reaction and group content. This is the human moment that makes the Reel relatable.
shots.location: Bar counter, camera positioned to capture both talent in medium frame with drinks visible
shots.subject: Nia and Kayla laughing together with cocktails

camera.framing: Medium shot, both talent from chest or waist up, both drinks visible in frame, pendant lights above
camera.zoomOrLens: 50mm equivalent to compress slightly and keep focus on talent

shots.talentDirection: Nia and Kayla: Keep talking, joking, reacting naturally. When something genuinely makes you laugh, let it happen. Hold your drinks naturally — sip them, gesture with them, whatever feels real. We're waiting for the authentic moment, not a forced one.
shots.editingNote: Find the most genuine laugh or reaction moment. This is the emotional peak of beat 3. Cut holds 2-3 seconds to let the moment land. Both talent and drinks should be clearly visible.

shots.title: Two Cocktails Side by Side Final Shot
shots.description: Final hero shot of two signature cocktails placed side by side on dark bar counter under perfect pendant lighting. Camera positioned straight-on or slightly overhead. THE PATIO branding visible but softly blurred in background. No people, no movement — just the drinks, the lighting, and the aesthetic. This is the hold-for-tag moment.
shots.purpose: Closing visual for beat 4 and location tag moment. Clean product shot that summarizes the vibe and gives space for text overlay.
shots.location: Bar counter under pendant light, THE PATIO signage positioned in background for soft blur
shots.subject: Two signature cocktails side by side

camera.framing: Straight-on or slightly overhead, two cocktails centered and side by side, THE PATIO branding visible but blurred in background
camera.zoomOrLens: 50mm equivalent to compress background and isolate drinks as hero subjects

shots.talentDirection: No talent in frame. Ensure both drinks are perfectly placed, garnishes are fresh, and lighting is even across both glasses.
shots.editingNote: This is the final frame of the Reel. Hold for full 4 seconds to allow location tag, text overlay, and viewer absorption. Ensure both drinks look perfect, colors pop against dark background, and THE PATIO branding is legible but not competing with drinks for attention. This shot carries the entire vibe.

photoPlan.title: Signature Dish — Untouched Hero
photoPlan.description: The signature dish plated by the chef, shot immediately after plating and before anyone touches it. This is the single best thing The Patio sells, captured in its perfect state under the warm pendant lighting at the bar counter.
photoPlan.location: Bar counter under pendant lights, dark surface
photoPlan.subject: Signature dish, plated and untouched

camera.framing: Tight overhead or 45-degree angle, dish fills frame

photoPlan.styling: Clean, minimalist composition on dark counter. Let the warm pendant light create natural shadows and depth. No hands, no distractions — just the dish.

photoPlan.title: Full Spread at the Bar
photoPlan.description: The complete experience laid out on the bar counter: signature dish, multiple cocktails, appetizers if available. This shows abundance and the full range of what The Patio offers in one frame.
photoPlan.location: Bar counter, wide section under pendant lights
photoPlan.subject: Full spread of food and cocktails

camera.framing: Wide overhead or elevated angle capturing the full counter spread

photoPlan.styling: Arrange dishes and cocktails with intentional spacing on the dark counter. Use the pendant lights to create pools of warm light. Include the stylized bar elements visible in the background if possible.

photoPlan.title: All Four on the Patio
photoPlan.description: All four talent together in the patio area — the hero group shot while everyone is still there and still looking good. This is the frame that shows the vibe and the crew together.
photoPlan.location: Patio area, best-lit or most visually interesting section
photoPlan.subject: Group of four talent

camera.framing: Medium-wide, all four visible and engaged with each other or the space

photoPlan.styling: Natural, candid energy. Let them interact with drinks or the space. Capture the patio aesthetic and the group dynamic together. This is BBO — confident, fun, not stiff.

photoPlan.title: Bar Counter Hero Zone
photoPlan.description: The hero location: bar counter with 'THE PATIO | KITCHEN' branding visible, pendant lights glowing, stylized cocktail and food elements in frame. This establishes the space and the brand in one shot.
photoPlan.location: Bar counter with branding signage visible in background
photoPlan.subject: Bar counter and venue branding

camera.framing: Wide or medium shot capturing counter, pendant lights, and 'THE PATIO | KITCHEN' signage

photoPlan.styling: Clean, architectural shot that shows the minimalist aesthetic and warm lighting. Include the stylized cocktail glasses and food plate if they enhance the composition. This is the money shot for the client's website.

photoPlan.title: Signature Cocktail — Untouched
photoPlan.description: One of the signature cocktails, shot immediately after the bartender finishes it. Clean, untouched, perfect. This is the cocktail content the client requested.
photoPlan.subject: Signature cocktail

camera.framing: Tight to medium, cocktail is the clear hero

photoPlan.styling: Isolate the cocktail on the dark counter. Use the warm pendant light to make the drink glow. Minimal background distractions — let the drink and the aesthetic speak.

photoPlan.title: Chef Plating the Signature Dish
photoPlan.description: The chef plating the signature dish in the kitchen — hands in motion, the dish coming together. This is the preparation content the client specifically requested and kitchen access allows.
photoPlan.subject: Chef plating signature dish

camera.framing: Medium to tight on hands and plate, chef's face optional but welcome
camera.angle: Slightly elevated or side angle to show the action

photoPlan.styling: Capture the motion and the craft. This is behind-the-scenes content that shows care and skill. Watch for good light in the kitchen — supplement if needed.

photoPlan.title: Patio Aesthetic Shot
photoPlan.description: The patio area itself — the space, the seating, the vibe. Owner specifically wants the patio in frame. This is the venue aesthetic content the client requested.
photoPlan.location: Patio area, widest or most representative view
photoPlan.subject: Patio space and aesthetic

camera.framing: Wide shot capturing the patio layout and vibe

photoPlan.styling: Show the space as a destination. If there's natural light, use it. If it's evening and lit artificially, lean into that mood. This is the frame that makes people want to pull up.

photoPlan.title: Talent at the Bar — Group Content
photoPlan.description: Two or three talent seated at the bar counter with drinks and food, naturally interacting. This is group content at the bar, fulfilling the client's group content request in a different setting than the patio.
photoPlan.location: Bar counter, talent seated or standing
photoPlan.subject: Talent interacting at the bar

camera.framing: Medium shot, multiple talent visible with drinks/food

photoPlan.styling: Natural, mid-moment energy. Capture conversation, laughter, or the moment someone reacts to the food. Pendant lights should create warm pools of light on faces. This is lifestyle content, not posed.

photoPlan.title: Cocktail Detail — Garnish and Glass
photoPlan.description: Extreme close-up on a cocktail detail: the garnish, the rim, the condensation on the glass, the color of the liquid catching light. This is the detail shot that shows craft and makes people thirsty.
photoPlan.subject: Cocktail detail

camera.framing: Tight close-up, one detail fills the frame

photoPlan.styling: Isolate one beautiful detail. Shallow depth of field if possible. Use the warm light to create mood. This is the shot that lives on the cocktail menu.

photoPlan.title: Signature Dish — First Bite
photoPlan.description: Talent taking the first bite of the signature dish, or the moment right after — the reaction, the fork in motion, the dish now lived-in. This is the human moment that follows the perfect plate.
photoPlan.subject: Talent eating signature dish

camera.framing: Medium to tight, talent and dish both visible

photoPlan.styling: Capture the genuine reaction. This is the frame that says 'it's really that good.' Watch the light on the face — supplement if the pendant lights aren't enough.

photoPlan.title: Individual Portrait — Kayla at the Bar
photoPlan.description: Solo portrait of Kayla at the bar counter with a cocktail, styled and confident. This is grid content for BBO talent and a lifestyle shot for the venue.
photoPlan.subject: Kayla, solo portrait

camera.framing: Medium shot, Kayla is the clear subject with cocktail or space as context

photoPlan.styling: Confident, direct energy. Use the warm pendant light as a key light. Let the dark minimalist background stay dark — it creates contrast and mood. This is BBO: she owns the space.

photoPlan.title: Bar Pendant Lights — Aesthetic Detail
photoPlan.description: The pendant lights themselves, glowing warm against the dark space. This is a pure aesthetic detail shot that reinforces the venue's visual identity and the minimalist vibe.
photoPlan.location: Bar counter area, looking up or angled toward lights
photoPlan.subject: Pendant lights

camera.framing: Tight to medium, lights are the subject

photoPlan.styling: Let the lights glow. Embrace the darkness around them. This is a mood shot, an interstitial image for carousels or transitions. Minimal context needed — just the light and the vibe.

photoPlan.title: Hands Holding Cocktails — Group Toast
photoPlan.description: Multiple hands holding cocktails in a toast or casual cheers moment at the bar. This is a detail-level group shot that focuses on the drinks and the gesture, not faces.
photoPlan.subject: Hands holding cocktails

camera.framing: Tight on hands and glasses, dark counter visible below

photoPlan.styling: Natural, mid-moment. Capture the glasses catching light, the hands in motion or paused. This is the shot that says 'we're here, we're together, we're having a good time.'

photoPlan.title: Kitchen Branding — 'THE PATIO | KITCHEN' Sign
photoPlan.description: Clean shot of 'THE PATIO | KITCHEN' branding visible in the space. This is a branding asset for the client and a transition image for content.
photoPlan.location: Bar counter area with branding visible in background
photoPlan.subject: Venue branding signage

camera.framing: Medium shot, signage clear and legible

photoPlan.styling: Clean, simple, architectural. Let the branding be the hero. This is a utility shot that the client will use everywhere.
